description_for_human: A collaborative platform for classical music knowledge — editions and recordings for every piece.
description_for_model: Irregular Pearl is a classical music knowledge base organized around individual musical works. Use this to look up information about classical music pieces including editions (publisher, editor, year), recordings, performance difficulty, duration, era, and form. Each piece page has structured metadata and edition comparisons. Access the full catalog at /llms-full.txt or search at /?q={query}.
